cards.ex: After a few weeks, I finally settled into a groove at my new job and started feeling productive.
cards.exUz: Bir necha haftadan so'ng, nihoyat yangi ishimda yo'lga tushdim va unumli ishlay boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishda o'z o'rnini topib, yaxshi natijalarga erishish, odatlanish.

cards.ex: This tiny apartment is a far cry from the spacious house they used to live in.
cards.exUz: Bu kichkina kvartira ularning ilgari yashagan keng uyidan butunlay boshqacha.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa o'rtasida katta farq borligini ifodalash.

cards.ex: He's a talented musician, but I don't think he's going to set the world on fire.
cards.exUz: U iste'dodli musiqachi, lekin o'ylamaymanki, u dunyoni hayratga soladi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatga erishish, hammaga ta'sir o'tkazish.

cards.ex: She eats, sleeps, and breathes photography; it's her whole life.
cards.exUz: U fotografiyaga jon-dildan berilgan; bu uning butun hayoti.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga butun hayotini bag'ishlash, juda qiziqish.

cards.ex: As a traveling salesman, he practically lives out of a suitcase.
cards.exUz: Sayohat qiluvchi sotuvchi sifatida u deyarli chamadon bilan yashaydi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida doimiy joyi bo'lmasdan, sayohat qilib yurish.

cards.ex: The exam was a walk in the park; I finished it in half the time.
cards.exUz: Imtihon juda oson edi; men uni yarmida tugatdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda oson va qiyinchiliksiz bo'lgan ish.

cards.ex: It's getting late; let's call it a day and finish the project tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Kech bo'lyapti; keling, ishni to'xtatamiz va loyihani ertaga tugatamiz.
cards.uzDef: Ishni tugatish va dam olish vaqtini e'lon qilish.

cards.ex: He's a brilliant scientist, but he's completely out of his element when he has to give presentations.
cards.exUz: U ajoyib olim, lekin taqdimot qilishi kerak bo'lganda butunlay o'z joyida emas.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga notanish muhitda o'zini noqulay his qilish.

cards.ex: They finally decided to take the plunge and buy a house.
cards.exUz: Ular nihoyat tavakkal qilishga va uy sotib olishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish, tavakkal qilib biror ishga kirishmoq.

cards.ex: I see this job as a means to an end; it's not my dream job, but it will help me pay off my debts.
cards.exUz: Men bu ishni maqsadga erishish uchun vosita deb bilaman; bu mening orzuyimdagi ish emas, lekin u menga qarzlarimni to'lashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun ishlatiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: Being a working parent is a constant balancing act between work and family.
cards.exUz: Ishlaydigan ota-ona bo'lish - bu doimiy ravishda ish va oila o'rtasida muvozanatni saqlash.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil talablarni qondirishga harakat qilish, qiyin vaziyatda muvozanatni saqlash.

cards.ex: The deadline isn't set in stone; we can probably push it back a week.
cards.exUz: Muddat qatiy belgilanmagan; biz uni ehtimol bir hafta orqaga surishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan, qat'iy qoidalar bilan belgilanadigan narsa.

cards.ex: He always goes the extra mile for his clients, which is why they're so loyal.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'z mijozlari uchun qo'shimcha harakat qiladi, shuning uchun ular shunchalik sodiqdir.
cards.uzDef: Talab qilinganidan ko'proq harakat qilish, yaxshiroq natijaga erishish uchun qo'shimcha urinish.

cards.ex: The team was completely out of sync; nobody knew what anyone else was doing.
cards.exUz: Jamoa butunlay kelishmovchilikda edi; hech kim boshqasining nima qilayotganini bilmasdi.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda ishlayotganda, harakatlarning muvofiqlashmaganligi.

cards.ex: Applying for that job was a shot in the dark, but I got it!
cards.exUz: O'sha ishga ariza topshirish tasodifiy urinish edi, lekin men uni oldim!
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotga asoslanmagan, tasodifiy urinish.

cards.ex: He was always teasing me, but he didn't like it when I gave him a taste of his own medicine.
cards.exUz: U har doim meni mazax qilardi, lekin men unga o'z darmonidan bir qultum berganimda unga yoqmadi.
cards.term: a taste of your own medicine
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga qilgan yomon muomalani o'zing boshdan kechirish.

cards.ex: She's set her sights on becoming a doctor and is working hard to get into medical school.
cards.exUz: U shifokor bo'lishni maqsad qilgan va tibbiyot universitetiga kirish uchun qattiq ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Erishmoqchi bo'lgan aniq maqsadni belgilash.

cards.ex: I need to go on vacation to recharge my batteries; I'm feeling completely drained.
cards.exUz: Men ta'tilga borib, kuch to'plamam kerak; men butunlay charchadim.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish orqali energiyani tiklash.

cards.ex: After such a successful CEO, the new one has a tough act to follow.
cards.exUz: Bunday muvaffaqiyatli bosh direktordan so'ng, yangi bosh direktor uchun qiyin vazifa turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining yutug'idan keyin yaxshiroq natijaga erishishning qiyinligi.

cards.ex: He lives and breathes football; it's all he ever talks about.
cards.exUz: U futbol bilan yashaydi va nafas oladi; u doimo faqat shu haqida gapiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan juda qiziqib, unga butun hayotini bag'ishlash.

cards.ex: Even though she lost the competition, she's keeping her chin up and focusing on the future.
cards.exUz: U musobaqada mag'lub bo'lganiga qaramay, u ruhiyatini tushirmayapti va kelajakka e'tibor qaratmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda umidni yo'qotmaslik, pozitiv bo'lish.

cards.ex: The heart attack was a wake-up call; he realized he needed to change his lifestyle.
cards.exUz: Yurak xuruji ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq bo'ldi; u o'z turmush tarzini o'zgartirishi kerakligini tushundi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan hodisa, muammo haqida ogohlantiruvchi signal.

cards.ex: He's just going through the motions at work; he's not really engaged anymore.
cards.exUz: U ishda shunchaki majburan ishlayapti; u endi chin dildan qatnashmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Ishni xohlamasdan, faqat bajarish uchun qilish.

cards.ex: You need to get a grip and stop panicking; everything will be alright.
cards.exUz: Siz o'zingizni tutishingiz va vahima qilishni to'xtatishingiz kerak; hamma narsa yaxshi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: O'zingni nazorat qila olmaslik, his-tuyg'ularni boshqarishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Her debut novel made a splash in the literary world.
cards.exUz: Uning birinchi romani adabiyot olamida hayratga soldi.
cards.uzDef: Hammaga ta'sir o'tkazish, diqqatga sazovor bo'lish.

cards.ex: They're living from day to day, never knowing where their next meal is coming from.
cards.exUz: Ular kunning g'amini yeb yashashadi, keyingi ovqat qayerdan kelishini hech qachon bilmaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakni o'ylamasdan, faqat hozirgi kun bilan yashash.

cards.ex: That documentary gave me a lot of food for thought about the environment.
cards.exUz: O'sha hujjatli film menga atrof-muhit haqida fikr uchun juda ko'p ozuqa berdi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlashga undaydigan narsa, yangi g'oyalar.

cards.ex: He's still recovering from the surgery, but he's definitely out of the woods now.
cards.exUz: U hali ham operatsiyadan tuzalmoqda, lekin u hozir xavfdan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli vaziyatdan chiqish, xavfsizlikka erishish.

cards.ex: Taxes are a necessary evil, but they fund important public services.
cards.exUz: Soliqlar majburiy yomonlik, lekin ular muhim davlat xizmatlarini moliyalashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz, lekin keraksiz bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: I'm not committing to anything yet; I want to keep my options open.
cards.exUz: Men hali hech narsaga va'da bermayapman; imkoniyatlarimni saqlab qolmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda turli xil variantlarni ko'rib chiqish imkoniyatini saqlab qolish.
